answer: Sybil resistance requires each identity to complete a VDF chain of modular squarings, with each step depending on the previous result. GPUs may accelerate arithmetic, but cannot parallelize steps within one chain. Cloned identities require separate chains and additional hardware to run concurrently, so each still incurs the full sequential delay. A mesa, grove, or terrace of fabricated names cannot eliminate this time cost; Wesolowski proofs make completed chains efficient to verify.
